scope: Corollary 6.1 of the manuscript “The periodic spin-one Haldane gap” (preprints/The-periodic-spin-one-Haldane-gap-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 268 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 989f14096403897c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the self-adjoint Hamiltonians (1.1), the normalized ground states of the even periodic rings have a subsequence, as L → ∞, converging on every local operator to a state ω. Every such limit satisfies ω(A∗ [H, A]) ≥ log 20 784 ( ω(A∗ A) − |ω(A)|2) (6.1) for every local operator A.
